claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows partial text on machine body possibly starting with 'NEL', but watermark obscures it and full brand cannot be confirmed as EMel.
No model plate or number is visible or legible in any photo; model claim cannot be checked against the report.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or motor may be faulty
risks.proof: Video clip of machine running, needle moving, and motor sound with pedal pressed

risks.risk: Brand/model may not match seller's claim, affecting parts availability and resale value
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of nameplate/model sticker without watermark obstruction
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unbranded industrial machine, worst case for parts compatibility

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, needles, extra thread cones, thread stand, foot press) may not be included in sale
risks.proof: Itemized photo or seller confirmation list of what is included in the sale price
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine-and-table only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Wiring and plug may be unsafe or non-compliant
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug, cord condition, and any visible fraying or exposed wires

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history could mean excessive wear on internal mechanisms
risks.proof: Seller-provided purchase date, service history, or maintenance receipts
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with no warranty

risks.risk: Stitch quality and mechanical alignment unverified
risks.proof: Video of machine stitching a sample fabric showing even tension and stitch formation

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed close-up photo of the full nameplate/model sticker on the machine body
Video of the machine powering on, running, and stitching a sample piece of fabric
Confirmation list of exactly what is included in the sale (thread stand, foot press, bobbins, needles, etc.)
Close-up photo of power cord and plug condition
Any available purchase receipt, warranty card, or service history
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial sewing machine with table and stand, so it can be priced at worst case, but brand/model, working condition, and included accessories remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proof is provided.
